`main/ui/site/DESIGN.md`:

```md
# NullCS / The Observatory

The website opens with the existing CT portrait without the previous helix. Graphite, chrome, silver, and restrained instrument lighting replace the previous blue presentation. The narrative moves through observation, recorded telemetry, the model pipeline, the local desktop tool, research, and interpretation.

## Implementation

- `src/components/cinematic/experience.tsx`: page narrative, actual telemetry controls, six-stage scroll sequence, motion control, and dimensional application showcase.
- `src/components/cinematic/instrument-engine.ts`: CSS 3D media cards and Three.js telemetry, physically based materials, a generated studio environment, and recorded-data traces. No third-party runtime asset requests are required.
- `src/components/cinematic/scene.tsx`: viewport-triggered dynamic import, lifecycle cleanup, WebGL failure handling, and CSS still-view fallback.
- `src/app/cinematic.css`: responsive art direction and motion. Native scrolling is retained; there is no scroll hijacking or mandatory introduction.
- `src/components/layout/site-header.tsx` and `site-footer.tsx`: persistent desktop CTA, mobile navigation, project links, and keyboard access.
- `/about` and `/analyze`: redesigned research and download pages. Existing API and historical job routes remain intact.
- `layout.tsx`, `robots.ts`, `sitemap.ts`, and `public/favicon.svg`: metadata, icon, download-page discovery, and a static no-JavaScript overview. The framework streams client-page content through a JavaScript reveal, so the no-JavaScript overview is intentionally separate from the interactive presentation.

New dependencies are `three` 0.174.0 and matching `@types/three` 0.174.0. The lockfile pins installed versions. No Python, research, model, calibration, inference, installer, or updater code was changed for this redesign.

## Data and claims

`public/assets/observatory/encounter-sample.json` contains the first 64 encounter rows from the verified local run of `TEST_20260501_102349_02b8afde.dem` (de_inferno). The three channels are `aim_error_min`, `mouse_delta_abs_mean`, and `angular_velocity_mean`; none of these selected values were null. Values were rounded to four decimal places for display. Player names and identifiers are omitted. Traces are independently normalized for geometry; the scrubber reports the recorded value with its unit. These are encounter summaries, not a reconstructed tick trajectory or a classification result.

The desktop image is a compressed capture of the actual ten-player result displayed by the native app in the preceding integration validation. The CT artwork is reused from the existing project; the processing-plane motifs are conceptual, not fabricated analysis output. Existing benchmark numbers and figures were retained with dataset and interpretation context. The research page documents the parser and calibrator limitations.

## Rendering and accessibility

Scenes load near their viewport and stop drawing offscreen or when the document is hidden. Rendering is capped at approximately 30 frames per second; DPR is capped at 1.5 on desktop and 1.25 on narrow screens. Sustained slow renders reduce DPR to 1. Geometry, materials, environment textures, observers, event listeners, and animation callbacks are disposed on unmount.

Motion preferences follow the OS, with a visible override. Reduced motion draws a static scene and replaces the long pinned pipeline with direct stage selection. Mobile uses direct stage controls and a separate composition. The SVG telemetry graph and textual pipeline remain available independently of WebGL. Context loss and unavailable WebGL fall back to the CT portrait (other scenes retain their CSS illustration). No-JavaScript visitors receive a static project overview and repository/release link.

The CT hero uses no WebGL canvas and a 68,098-byte WebP derived from the existing portrait. These are local asset/render counts, not production frame-rate guarantees.

## Download and deployment

The existing server-side `NULLCS_DESKTOP_DOWNLOAD_URL` validation is unchanged: only an HTTPS `.exe` release URL under `github.com/gjones01/NullCS/releases/download/` is accepted, without credentials, query, or fragment. No release URL was invented. The page remains disabled until a real signed public release is configured. See the root `DESKTOP_RELEASE.md` for signing and publication requirements.

Build with `npm.cmd run build`; run with `npm.cmd run start -- --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3002`. The local verification preview uses port 3002. Existing Vercel environment settings, including `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL`, remain applicable. This work was not deployed or published.

## Verification record

Production build and TypeScript check passed. Existing `node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/analysis-security.test.mjs` passed both tests. Browser validation used the production build in headless Microsoft Edge at 1440×1000, 390×844, and 320-pixel widths, with screenshots inspected manually.

Verified real WebGL rendering, all six scroll stages, direct mobile stage selection, telemetry channel/scrubber updates, mobile navigation, the existing release gate, motion pause, OS reduced motion, forced WebGL context loss, WebGL-unavailable behavior, and the visible no-JavaScript overview. The final browser run recorded no console/runtime errors or failed resource responses. The WCAG 2 A/AA and 2.1 AA axe checks on the home and download pages reported no violations after contrast corrections. Automated checks do not replace a complete manual accessibility audit or physical-device GPU testing.

## Existing dependency advisories

The production dependency audit reported five affected packages: Next.js (critical), sharp and source-map-js (high), fflate (moderate), and dompurify (low). Three.js itself was not listed. These advisories concern the existing dependency graph and were not addressed with a broad upgrade during this visual task. Resolve and revalidate them before public deployment; the local production preview is bound to loopback. The audit details and browser evidence are in the ignored local `main/data/web_validation` directory.

## Illustrated pipeline cards (2026-10-09)

The hero helix has been removed; the existing CT portrait remains. The six-stage scroll sequence now uses perspective-transformed HTML cards so video controls, tables, and diagrams remain accessible and sharp. Native scrolling and the existing stage navigation remain. Inactive cards are inert; reduced motion disables transitions and diagram animation. No ML code or result semantics changed.

Card sources:

1. Demo: user-supplied `NullCS BRoll.mov`, converted to local `nullcs-broll.mp4` (H.264, 1280x720, fast-start, audio track removed). Original MOV is unchanged. Native video is muted, loops, plays inline, and hides playback controls. Autoplay follows motion preference; the video unmounts offscreen, on stage change, or while the tab is hidden. There are no third-party video requests. The original MOV is excluded from git and Vercel upload; only the optimized copy and poster are needed for the website.
2. Telemetry: seven actual encounter-summary rows from the existing `encounter-sample.json`, with feature units; these are not raw tick rows.
3. Windows: existing `real-visibility-context-timeline.png`, compressed to WebP. Actual encounter summaries from `TEST_20260407_130853_1f420890`, explicitly distinguished from a raw 32-tick sequence.
4. Temporal model: a conceptual neural network with curved, flowing connections and subtly drifting nodes. Layer labels retain the verified 64/96/128 channel progression and pooling/head stage; displayed node counts and motion are illustrative, not measured activations or literal model topology. Animation runs only for the active card and respects reduced motion.
5. Aggregation: existing real within-lobby multi-lens percentile chart, compressed to WebP; not a cheating probability or a new ranking formula. Source generator: `main/scripts/generate_real_trailer_graphs.py`.
6. Review: existing real desktop results screenshot from local validation. The footage and individual evidence samples are not presented as a single linked demo run.

Production build, six-stage desktop scroll, mobile stage selection, no horizontal overflow, reduced-motion behavior, and home axe checks were exercised using local validation scripts under `main/data/web_validation`. On October 10 the rebuilt site passed these checks again, plus About navigation and the unavailable-release download state, at http://127.0.0.1:3004. The current video is local and silent. Not deployed.

```

`main/ui/site/src/app/about/page.tsx`:

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Image from "next/image";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ArrowUpRight } from "lucide-react";
import { githubUrl, proofCards, benchmarkStats } from "@/lib/site-content";
export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "Research notes",
  description:
    "The methodology, limitations, and independent research behind NullCS behavioral demo analysis.",
};
export default function AboutPage() {
  return (
    <article className="subpage">
      <div className="section-register">
        <span>NULLCS / RESEARCH NOTES</span>
        <span>AN OPEN INVESTIGATION</span>
      </div>
      <h1>
        Behavior deserves
        <br />
        <em>a closer look.</em>
      </h1>
      <p className="subpage-intro">
        NullCS is an end-to-end data science project for Counter-Strike 2:
        replay parsing, behavioral feature engineering, temporal modeling,
        player ranking, and a local desktop application. It turns match telemetry
        into a ranked list of players for replay review.
      </p>
      <div className="research-chapter" style={{ marginTop: 70 }}>
        <div>
          <span className="technical-label">01 / METHODOLOGY</span>
          <h2>
            From telemetry
            <br />
            to review priority.
          </h2>
        </div>
        <div>
          <p>
            The pipeline parses gameplay telemetry and builds encounter windows.
            A temporal neural network reads encounter sequences; shared
            aggregation combines those outputs with engineered behavioral
            features. A gradient-boosted model ranks players within a match.
          </p>
          <p>
            The player-level feature contract contains 449 features. Training
            and inference share aggregation logic. Five-fold grouped evaluation
            uses demo IDs to keep matches separate across player-model folds.
          </p>
          <p>
            Timing, visibility, aim correction, movement pressure, and input
            behavior provide complementary signals. The report separates the
            raw model output, calibrated estimate, and evidence-adjusted review score.
          </p>
          <p>
            The parser rejects missing required model inputs. Inference records
            model and parser provenance, making version changes and input failures
            traceable when CS2 updates.
          </p>
          <Link className="text-link" href="/#pipeline">
            Explore the process <ArrowUpRight size={16} />
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="research-chapter">
        <div>
          <span className="technical-label">02 / EVALUATION</span>
          <h2>
            Benchmark context
            <br />
            is part of the result.
          </h2>
        </div>
        <div>
          <p>
            The existing public CS2CD benchmark reports 860 demos after
            filtering, with 992 positive and 5,894 negative player-demo rows.
            Retrieval figures refer to 293 demos containing a suspicious-player
            label.
          </p>
          <p>
            Historical player-model out-of-fold predictions yield average
            precision of 0.805 and ROC-AUC of 0.959. Threshold tables expose the
            tradeoff between finding labeled cases and raising false alarms;
            score distributions show where the labeled groups overlap.
          </p>
          <p>
            These measurements describe this dataset and evaluation procedure.
            They do not establish production accuracy on unseen CS2 patches,
            skill distributions, or every type of behavioral anomaly.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="benchmark-strip">
        {benchmarkStats.map((stat) => (
          <div key={stat.label}>
            <span className="technical-label">{stat.label}</span>
            <strong>{stat.value}</strong>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <details className="research-figures" style={{ marginTop: 30 }}>
        <summary>
          Inspect the existing research figures <span>+</span>
        </summary>
        <div>
          {proofCards.map((card) => (
            <figure key={card.image}>
              <Image
                src={card.image}
                alt={card.title}
                width={1000}
                height={700}
                sizes="(max-width:760px) 90vw, 45vw"
              />
              <figcaption>
                {card.title}. {card.body}
              </figcaption>
            </figure>
          ))}
        </div>
      </details>
      <div className="research-chapter">
        <div>
          <span className="technical-label">03 / INTERPRETATION</span>
          <h2>Interpret the evidence.</h2>
        </div>
        <div>
          <p>
            Some replays show clear cheating behavior. Other cases need encounter
            context: visibility, timing, player skill, and what information was
            available. Strong model signals focus that review; false positives
            and missed cases are measured in the evaluation.
          </p>
          <p>
            Review score, raw model score, and calibrated probability are
            different concepts. Some model selections lack calibration;
            estimates from labeled data may not generalize to a new match.
          </p>
          <p>
            Next research direction: compare the same player across multiple
            demos, measuring whether unusual behavior repeats. The current app
            processes one demo at a time; player-history analysis is not yet available.
          </p>
          <p>
            The verified demoparser2 0.41.4 runtime has a known stale
            user-command-value issue. The saved calibrator also produces a
            scikit-learn version warning. Passing the parser column contract
            does not prove that every input value is fresh. These limitations
            are preserved and documented, not hidden by the interface.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="research-chapter">
        <div>
          <span className="technical-label">04 / THE RESEARCHER</span>
          <h2>Gerry Jones, Jr.</h2>
        </div>
        <div>
          <p>
            NullCS is an independent project by Gerry Jones, Jr., who holds a
            B.S. in Applied Mathematics and is pursuing a master's degree in
            Data Science.
          </p>
          <p>
            The project began after returning to Counter-Strike in April 2025
            and asking whether post-match demo data could support more
            structured review. That question led to demo collection, player
            labeling, feature engineering, model evaluation, and continued
            investigation of difficult cases.
          </p>
          <p>
            This is ongoing research. NullCS is not a kernel anticheat, a
            universal detector, or an automated enforcement system.
          </p>
          <a
            className="text-link"
            href={githubUrl}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noreferrer"
          >
            Examine the repository <ArrowUpRight size={16} />
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <Link className="instrument-button" href="/analyze">
        Get the desktop application <ArrowUpRight size={18} />
      </Link>
    </article>
  );
}
```

`main/ui/site/src/app/analyze/[jobId]/page.tsx`:

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { AnalysisWorkspace } from "@/components/analyze/analysis-workspace";
export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Demo analysis", robots: { index: false, follow: false } };
export default async function AnalysisPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ jobId: string }> }) {
  const { jobId } = await params;
  if (!/^TEST_\d{14}_[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(jobId)) notFound();
  return <AnalysisWorkspace key={jobId} jobId={jobId} />;
}
```

`main/ui/site/src/app/api/analysis/[[...segments]]/route.ts`:

```ts
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { analysisGateway } from "@/lib/analysis-gateway";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
export const maxDuration = 30;

type Context = { params: Promise<{ segments?: string[] }> };
export async function GET(request: NextRequest, context: Context) {
  return analysisGateway(request, (await context.params).segments || []);
}
export async function POST(request: NextRequest, context: Context) {
  return analysisGateway(request, (await context.params).segments || []);
}
```

```ts
import type { MetadataRoute } from "next";

const siteUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL || "http://localhost:3000";

export default function sitemap(): MetadataRoute.Sitemap {
  return [
    {
      url: siteUrl,
      lastModified: new Date(),
      changeFrequency: "weekly",
      priority: 1,
    },
    {
      url: `${siteUrl}/about`,
      lastModified: new Date(),
      changeFrequency: "monthly",
      priority: 0.8,
    },
    {
      url: `${siteUrl}/analyze`,
      lastModified: new Date(),
      changeFrequency: "monthly",
      priority: 0.9,
    },
  ];
}
```

`main/ui/site/src/components/analytics/pageview-tracker.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { posthog } from "@/lib/posthog";

export function PageViewTracker() {
  const pathname = usePathname();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pathname || !posthog.__loaded) return;
    posthog.capture("$pageview", {
      $current_url: `${window.location.origin}${pathname}`,
    });
  }, [pathname]);

  return null;
}
```

`main/ui/site/src/components/analyze/analysis-workspace.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { ArrowUpRight, FileUp, Loader2, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";
import type { AnalysisResult, AnalysisStatus, EvidenceTable, Explanation } from "@/lib/analysis-types";

async function api<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const response = await fetch(`/api/analysis${path}`, { ...init, cache: "no-store" });
  const data = await response.json().catch(() => null);
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data?.error?.message || "The analysis service could not complete this request.");
  return data as T;
}
const percent = (value: number | null) => value === null ? "Unavailable" : `${(value * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
const panel = "rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-[#0b1018]/90 p-5 sm:p-7";
const action = "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg metallic-button bg-primary px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-primary-foreground transition hover:brightness-110 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-45";

export function AnalysisWorkspace({ jobId }: { jobId?: string }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [limit, setLimit] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [uploadPercent, setUploadPercent] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<AnalysisStatus | null>(null);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<AnalysisResult | null>(null);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState("");
  const [explanation, setExplanation] = useState<Explanation | null>(null);
  const [evidence, setEvidence] = useState<EvidenceTable | null>(null);
  const [evidenceBusy, setEvidenceBusy] = useState(false);
  const [explainError, setExplainError] = useState("");
  const upload = useRef<XMLHttpRequest | null>(null);
  const evidenceRequest = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (jobId) return;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    api<{ max_upload_bytes: number }>("/capabilities", { signal: controller.signal }).then((data) => setLimit(data.max_upload_bytes)).catch((e) => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setError(e.message); });
    return () => { controller.abort(); upload.current?.abort(); };
  }, [jobId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!jobId) return;
    let disposed = false;
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    async function poll() {
      try {
        const next = await api<AnalysisStatus>(`/${jobId}/status`, { signal: controller.signal });
        if (disposed) return;
        setStatus(next); setError("");
        if (next.state === "results_ready") {
          const payload = await api<AnalysisResult>(`/${jobId}/results`, { signal: controller.signal });
          if (!disposed) { setResult(payload); setSelected((old) => old || payload.players[0]?.steamid || ""); }
          return;
        }
        if (next.state === "failed") return;
      } catch (e) { if (!disposed) setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unable to refresh status."); }
      if (!disposed) timer = setTimeout(poll, 4000);
    }
    void poll();
    return () => { disposed = true; controller.abort(); clearTimeout(timer); };
  }, [jobId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!jobId || !selected) return;
    let disposed = false;
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    evidenceRequest.current?.abort();
    setExplanation(null); setEvidence(null); setEvidenceBusy(false); setExplainError("");
    async function poll() {
      try {
        const next = await api<Explanation>(`/${jobId}/players/${selected}/explanation`, { signal: controller.signal });
        if (disposed) return;
        setExplanation(next);
        if (next.status.state === "queued" || next.status.state === "running") timer = setTimeout(poll, 4000);
      } catch (e) { if (!disposed) setExplainError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Explanation unavailable."); }
    }
    void poll();
    return () => { disposed = true; controller.abort(); evidenceRequest.current?.abort(); clearTimeout(timer); };
  }, [jobId, selected, busy]);

  function choose(next: File | null) {
    setError("");
    if (next && (!next.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(".dem") || (limit !== null && next.size > limit))) {
      setError("Choose a .dem file within the upload limit."); setFile(null); return;
    }
    setFile(next);
  }

  async function submit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!file || busy) return;
    setBusy(true); setError(""); setUploadPercent(0);
    try {
      const ticket = await api<{ job_id: string; upload_url: string; upload_token: string }>("", {
        method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ filename: file.name, size: file.size }),
      });
      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
        const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest(); upload.current = xhr;
        xhr.open("PUT", ticket.upload_url);
        xhr.setRequestHeader("Authorization", `Bearer ${ticket.upload_token}`);
        xhr.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream");
        xhr.upload.onprogress = (e) => { if (e.lengthComputable) setUploadPercent(Math.round(e.loaded / e.total * 100)); };
        xhr.onload = () => {
          if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) resolve();
          else { let message = "Upload failed. Please select the demo again."; try { message = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText).error?.message || message; } catch {} reject(new Error(message)); }
        };
        xhr.onerror = () => reject(new Error("Could not reach the upload worker. Check your connection and try again."));
        xhr.onabort = () => reject(new Error("Upload cancelled."));
        xhr.send(file);
      });
      router.push(`/analyze/${ticket.job_id}`);
    } catch (e) { setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Upload failed."); }
    finally { setBusy(false); setUploadPercent(null); }
  }

  async function explain() {
    setBusy(true); setExplainError("");
    try { await api(`/${jobId}/players/${selected}/explain`, { method: "POST" }); }
    catch (e) { setExplainError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not start explanation."); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }
  async function loadEvidence(filename: string) {
    evidenceRequest.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    evidenceRequest.current = controller;
    setEvidenceBusy(true); setExplainError("");
    try {
      const table = await api<EvidenceTable>(`/${jobId}/players/${selected}/evidence/${encodeURIComponent(filename)}`, { signal: controller.signal });
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) setEvidence(table);
    }
    catch (e) { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setExplainError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Evidence unavailable."); }
    finally { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setEvidenceBusy(false); }
  }
  const player = result?.players.find((p) => p.steamid === selected);

  return <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl px-5 pb-24 pt-16 sm:px-8">
    <div className="mb-9 max-w-3xl">
      <p className="mb-3 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-primary">NullCS / Demo analysis</p>
      <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold sm:text-5xl">A closer look at the match.</h1>
      <p className="mt-5 leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">Real model-derived behavioral signals, ranked for analyst review. A score is not a cheating verdict or a basis for an automatic ban.</p>
      <p role="note" className="mt-5 rounded-lg border border-primary/25 bg-primary/5 px-4 py-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground"><span className="mr-2 font-semibold text-primary">Beta</span>Analysis will keep improving as models are refined and retrained on newer data.</p>
    </div>
    {error && <div role="alert" className="mb-6 rounded-xl border border-rose-400/30 bg-rose-500/10 p-4 text-sm text-rose-100">{error}</div>}
    {!jobId ? <form onSubmit={submit} className={`${panel} max-w-3xl`}>
      <div onDragOver={(e) => e.preventDefault()} onDrop={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (!busy) choose(e.dataTransfer.files[0] || null); }} className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-primary/40 bg-primary/5 p-8 text-center">
        <FileUp className="mx-auto mb-4 h-9 w-9 text-primary" aria-hidden="true" />
        <label htmlFor="demo-file" className="block text-lg font-semibold">Select or drop a CS2 demo</label>
        <p className="mb-5 mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{limit ? `.dem files up to ${(limit / 1024 ** 3).toFixed(1)} GiB` : "Checking analysis availability…"}</p>
        <input id="demo-file" type="file" accept=".dem" disabled={busy || !limit} onChange={(e) => choose(e.target.files?.[0] || null)} className="max-w-full text-sm file:mr-4 file:rounded-md file:border-0 file:bg-white/10 file:px-4 file:py-2 file:text-white" />
        {file && <p className="mt-4 break-all text-sm">{file.name} · {(file.size / 1024 ** 2).toFixed(1)} MiB</p>}
      </div>
      <p className="my-5 flex items-start gap-2 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground"><ShieldCheck className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />Only upload demos you are authorized to submit. Results are private to this browser session. Clearing cookies removes your access. Uploaded demos and results are retained by the service until its operator removes them.</p>
      <button className={action} disabled={!file || !limit || busy}>{busy ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <ArrowUpRight className="h-4 w-4" />}{busy ? `Uploading${uploadPercent !== null ? ` · ${uploadPercent}%` : ""}` : "Upload and analyze"}</button>
      {busy && <button type="button" onClick={() => upload.current?.abort()} className="ml-4 text-sm underline">Cancel upload</button>}
    </form> : <>
      <div className={`${panel} mb-6`} aria-live="polite">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div><p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground">Analysis status</p><h2 className="mt-2 text-xl font-semibold">{status?.stage_label || "Loading analysis…"}</h2><p className="mt-1 break-all text-sm text-muted-foreground">{status?.filename}</p></div>
          <Link href="/analyze" className="text-sm text-primary underline underline-offset-4">Analyze another demo</Link>
        </div>
        {status?.error && <p role="alert" className="mt-4 text-rose-200">{status.error.message}</p>}
        {status && !["results_ready", "failed"].includes(status.state) && <p className="mt-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">This stage reflects worker activity. Processing time depends on the replay and available resources; there is no estimated completion percentage.</p>}
        {status?.runtime_seconds !== null && status?.runtime_seconds !== undefined && <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Inference runtime: {status.runtime_seconds.toFixed(1)} seconds on this worker.</p>}
      </div>
      {result && <>
        <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-3"><h2 className="text-2xl font-semibold">Players ranked for review</h2><p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{result.demo.map_name} · {result.players.length} eligible players</p></div>
        {result.warnings.map((warning) => <p key={warning.code} className="mb-3 rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-white/[0.03] p-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{warning.message}</p>)}
        <p className="mb-5 mt-5 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Ordered by the pipeline’s review score. Model score is the raw output; calibration is shown only when available. Review score includes the existing evidence adjustments.</p>
        <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.15fr)_minmax(0,1fr)]">
          <div className={`${panel} overflow-x-auto`}>
            <table className="w-full text-left text-sm"><thead><tr className="border-b border-white/10 text-xs text-muted-foreground"><th className="pb-3 pr-3">Rank / player</th><th className="pb-3 pr-3">Review</th><th className="pb-3 pr-3">Model</th><th className="pb-3">Calibrated</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>{result.players.map((p) => <tr key={p.steamid} className={`border-b border-white/5 ${p.steamid === selected ? "bg-primary/10" : ""}`}><td className="py-4 pr-3"><button aria-pressed={p.steamid === selected} onClick={() => setSelected(p.steamid)} className="text-left font-medium hover:text-primary"><span className="mr-2 text-primary">#{p.rank}</span>{p.attacker_name || p.steamid}</button></td><td className="pr-3">{percent(p.risk)}</td><td className="pr-3">{percent(p.model_score)}</td><td>{percent(p.calibrated_probability)}</td></tr>)}</tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
          {player && <div className={panel}>
            <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-primary">Player review</p><h3 className="mt-2 break-words text-xl font-semibold">{player.attacker_name || player.steamid}</h3><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Steam ID {player.steamid}</p>
            <p className="mt-4 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{player.interpretation?.behavior_profile?.summary}</p>
            <p className="mt-3 text-sm">Evidence confidence: {percent(player.confidence)}</p>
            <ul className="my-5 space-y-2 text-sm">{player.top_reasons.map((reason) => <li key={reason.title} className="border-l-2 border-primary/50 pl-3">{reason.title}</li>)}</ul>
            <div className="border-t border-white/10 pt-5"><h4 className="font-semibold">Explanation &amp; evidence</h4>
              <p className="mb-4 mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{explanation?.status.state === "ready" ? "Generated from this player’s stored match evidence." : "Scoring is complete. Explanations are generated separately when requested."}</p>
              {explainError && <p role="alert" className="mb-3 text-sm text-rose-200">{explainError}</p>}
              {explanation?.status.error && <p role="alert" className="mb-3 text-sm text-rose-200">{explanation.status.error}</p>}
              {explanation?.status.state !== "ready" && <button className={action} disabled={busy || ["queued", "running"].includes(explanation?.status.state || "")} onClick={explain}>{["queued", "running"].includes(explanation?.status.state || "") ? `Explanation ${explanation?.status.state}` : explanation?.status.state === "failed" ? "Retry explanation" : "Generate explanation"}</button>}
              {explanation?.report?.reasons?.map((reason, i) => <div key={i} className="mt-4 text-sm"><p className="font-medium">{reason.title || reason.reason}</p><p className="mt-1 leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{reason.summary}</p></div>)}
              <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap gap-2">{explanation?.report?.evidence_files?.map((name) => <button key={name} disabled={evidenceBusy} onClick={() => loadEvidence(name)} className="rounded-lg border border-white/15 px-3 py-2 text-xs hover:border-primary">{name.replace("evidence_", "").replace(".csv", "").replaceAll("_", " ")}</button>)}</div>
              {explanation?.status.state === "ready" && !explanation.report?.evidence_files?.length && <p className="mt-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">No evidence tables were produced for this player.</p>}
            </div>
          </div>}
        </div>
        {evidence && <div className={`${panel} mt-6 overflow-x-auto`}><h3 className="mb-4 font-semibold">{evidence.filename}</h3><table className="text-left text-xs"><thead><tr>{evidence.columns.map((column) => <th key={column} className="whitespace-nowrap border-b border-white/15 p-2">{column}</th>)}</tr></thead><tbody>{evidence.rows.map((row, i) => <tr key={i}>{evidence.columns.map((column) => <td key={column} className="max-w-xs truncate border-b border-white/5 p-2">{row[column] === null ? "—" : String(row[column])}</td>)}</tr>)}</tbody></table>{evidence.truncated && <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Showing the first 2,000 rows.</p>}</div>}
        <details className="mt-7 text-xs text-muted-foreground"><summary className="cursor-pointer">Model and parser provenance</summary><dl className="mt-3 space-y-2 break-all"><div>Model: {result.model.artifact_name}</div><div>SHA-256: {result.model.sha256}</div><div>Feature contract: {result.model.feature_list_sha256}</div><div>Parser: {result.demo.parser_provenance.demoparser2_version || "Unavailable"} · CS2 patch: {result.demo.parser_provenance.patch_version || "Unavailable"}</div></dl></details>
      </>}
    </>}
  </div>;
}
```

`main/ui/site/src/components/cinematic/instrument-engine.ts`:

```ts
import * as THREE from "three";
import { RoomEnvironment } from "three/addons/environments/RoomEnvironment.js";

export type SceneState = {
  progress: number;
  stage: number;
  channel: number;
  motion: boolean;
};
export type SceneOptions = {
  mode: "hero" | "pipeline" | "telemetry";
  samples?: number[][];
  read: () => SceneState;
  ready: (value: boolean) => void;
};

/** Recorded telemetry and supporting analytical geometry. */
export function mountInstrument(host: HTMLElement, options: SceneOptions) {
  const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
    antialias: true,
    alpha: true,
    powerPreference: "low-power",
  });
  renderer.setPixelRatio(
    Math.min(devicePixelRatio, innerWidth < 760 ? 1.25 : 1.5),
  );
  renderer.setClearColor(0x000000, 0);
  renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
  renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.25;
  renderer.domElement.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  host.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
  const scene = new THREE.Scene();
  const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(34, 1, 0.1, 60);
  camera.position.set(0, 0, 10);
  const pmrem = new THREE.PMREMGenerator(renderer);
  const room = new RoomEnvironment();
  const environment = pmrem.fromScene(room, 0.04);
  scene.environment = environment.texture;
  room.dispose();
  pmrem.dispose();
  const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xf3f0e5, 4);
  key.position.set(-3, 5, 6);
  scene.add(key);
  const rim = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xabb8c4, 3);
  rim.position.set(4, -1, 3);
  scene.add(rim);
  scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.35));
  const metal = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: 0x555a5c,
    metalness: 1,
    roughness: 0.22,
  });
  const dark = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: 0x151718,
    metalness: 0.9,
    roughness: 0.31,
  });
  const rig = new THREE.Group();
  scene.add(rig);
  const instrument = new THREE.Group();
  rig.add(instrument);
  // Analytical layers: the same instrument opens into six processing planes.
  const layers = new THREE.Group();
  rig.add(layers);
  const plates: THREE.Group[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    const group = new THREE.Group();
    const plate = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(2.7, 1.8, 0.07),
      i % 2 ? dark : metal,
    );
    group.add(plate);
    const edge = new THREE.LineSegments(
      new THREE.EdgesGeometry(plate.geometry),
      new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
        color: 0xadb2a9,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.4,
      }),
    );
    group.add(edge);
    const lines: number[] = [];
    const segment = (x: number, y: number, x2: number, y2: number) =>
      lines.push(x, y, 0.06, x2, y2, 0.06);
    const rect = (x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number) => {
      segment(x, y, x + w, y);
      segment(x + w, y, x + w, y + h);
      segment(x + w, y + h, x, y + h);
      segment(x, y + h, x, y);
    };
    if (i === 0) {
      rect(-0.5, -0.65, 1, 1.3);
      for (let j = 0; j < 5; j++)
        segment(-0.3, -0.4 + j * 0.18, 0.25, -0.4 + j * 0.18);
    }
    if (i === 1) {
      for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++)
        for (let k = 0; k < 25; k++) {
          const x = k * 0.08 - 1;
          segment(
            x,
            Math.sin(k * 0.8 + j) * 0.13 + (j - 1) * 0.4,
            x + 0.08,
            Math.sin((k + 1) * 0.8 + j) * 0.13 + (j - 1) * 0.4,
          );
        }
    }
    if (i === 2) {
      for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
        rect(-1 + j * 0.52, -0.5, 0.42, 1);
        for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++)
          segment(
            -0.94 + j * 0.52,
            -0.3 + k * 0.2,
            -0.67 + j * 0.52,
            -0.3 + k * 0.2,
          );
      }
    }
    if (i === 3) {
      for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++)
        for (let a = 0; a < 4; a++)
          for (let b = 0; b < 4; b++)
            segment(
              -0.9 + j * 0.6,
              -0.5 + a * 0.33,
              -0.9 + (j + 1) * 0.6,
              -0.5 + b * 0.33,
            );
    }
    if (i === 4) {
      segment(0, 0.65, 0, 0.3);
      segment(-0.7, 0.05, 0, 0.3);
      segment(0.7, 0.05, 0, 0.3);
      segment(-0.7, 0.05, -1, -0.4);
      segment(-0.7, 0.05, -0.4, -0.4);
      segment(0.7, 0.05, 0.4, -0.4);
      segment(0.7, 0.05, 1, -0.4);
    }
    if (i === 5) {
      for (let j = 0; j < 5; j++) rect(-1, 0.5 - j * 0.24, 1.9 - j * 0.25, 0.1);
    }
    const marks = new THREE.LineSegments(
      new THREE.BufferGeometry().setAttribute(
        "position",
        new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(lines, 3),
      ),
      new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
        color: 0xc4cda9,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.55,
      }),
    );
    group.add(marks);
    layers.add(group);
    plates.push(group);
  }
  const signals = new THREE.Group();
  rig.add(signals);
  const traces: THREE.Line[] = [];
  (options.samples || []).forEach((values, j) => {
    const max = Math.max(...values, 0.001);
    const points = values.map(
      (v, i) =>
        new THREE.Vector3(
          (i / (values.length - 1)) * 6 - 3,
          (v / max) * 1.8 - 0.6,
          (j - 1) * 1.2,
        ),
    );
    const line = new THREE.Line(
      new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(points),
      new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
        color: j === 0 ? 0xc4cda9 : 0x777e81,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.85,
      }),
    );
    signals.add(line);
    traces.push(line);
    const base = new THREE.Line(
      new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([
        new THREE.Vector3(-3, -0.65, (j - 1) * 1.2),
        new THREE.Vector3(3, -0.65, (j - 1) * 1.2),
      ]),
      new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0x45494a }),
    );
    signals.add(base);
  });
  const cursor = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.015, 2.4, 3.1),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
      color: 0xd9dfc7,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.16,
    }),
  );
  signals.add(cursor);
  instrument.visible = options.mode === "hero";
  layers.visible = options.mode === "pipeline";
  signals.visible = options.mode === "telemetry";
  const pointer = { x: 0, y: 0 };
  let visible = false,
    disposed = false,
    frame = 0,
    last = 0,
    elapsed = 0,
    slowFrames = 0,
    reducedQuality = false,
    lastStatic = "";
  function move(e: PointerEvent) {
    const rect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
    pointer.x = (e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width - 0.5;
    pointer.y = (e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height - 0.5;
  }
  function resize() {
    const w = host.clientWidth,
      h = host.clientHeight;
    if (!w || !h) return;
    renderer.setSize(w, h);
    camera.aspect = w / h;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    lastStatic = "";
  }
  const resizer = new ResizeObserver(resize);
  resizer.observe(host);
  resize();
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
    ([entry]) => {
      visible = entry.isIntersecting;
    },
    { threshold: 0.01 },
  );
  observer.observe(host);
  function lost(event: Event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    visible = false;
    options.ready(false);
  }
  renderer.domElement.addEventListener("webglcontextlost", lost);
  host.addEventListener("pointermove", move, { passive: true });
  function tick(now: number) {
    if (disposed) return;
    frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    if (!visible || document.hidden || now - last < 33) return;
    const state = options.read();
    const dt = Math.min(now - last, 80);
    last = now;
    const staticKey = `${state.stage}:${state.channel}`;
    if (!state.motion && lastStatic === staticKey) return;
    if (state.motion) elapsed += dt / 1000;
    const p = state.motion ? state.progress : 0;
    const px = state.motion ? pointer.x : 0,
      py = state.motion ? pointer.y : 0;
    const easing = state.motion ? 0.06 : 1;
    rig.rotation.x +=
      ((options.mode === "telemetry" ? 0.35 : 0.18) +
        py * 0.15 -
        rig.rotation.x) *
      easing;
    rig.rotation.y +=
      ((options.mode === "hero"
        ? -0.42
        : options.mode === "pipeline"
          ? -0.65
          : -0.25) +
        px * 0.22 +
        p * 0.35 -
        rig.rotation.y) *
      easing;
    rig.rotation.z =
      options.mode === "hero" ? -0.18 + Math.sin(elapsed * 0.15) * 0.025 : 0;
    if (options.mode === "hero") {
      instrument.rotation.z = 0.14 + p * 0.12;
      instrument.rotation.y = elapsed * 0.12 + p * 0.5;
      instrument.position.z = p * 0.5;
      rig.position.y = Math.sin(elapsed * 0.4) * 0.035;
      camera.position.z = Math.max(8.9, 10 / camera.aspect);
    }
    if (options.mode === "pipeline") {
      plates.forEach((plate, i) => {
        const z = i === state.stage ? 1.9 : (i - 2.5) * 0.52;
        const x = i === state.stage ? -0.45 : 0.35;
        plate.position.z += (z - plate.position.z) * (state.motion ? 0.08 : 1);
        plate.position.x += (x - plate.position.x) * (state.motion ? 0.08 : 1);
        (plate.children[0] as THREE.Mesh).material =
          i === state.stage ? metal : dark;
      });
      rig.rotation.z = -0.16;
      camera.position.z = 9.6;
    }
    if (options.mode === "telemetry") {
      traces.forEach((line, i) => {
        (line.material as THREE.LineBasicMaterial).color.setHex(
          i === state.channel ? 0xd5dfb4 : 0x60686a,
        );
      });
      cursor.position.x = Math.sin(elapsed * 0.28) * 2.9;
      camera.position.z = Math.max(6, 11 / camera.aspect);
    }
    const started = performance.now();
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
    lastStatic = state.motion ? "" : staticKey;
    if (performance.now() - started > 28) slowFrames++;
    if (slowFrames > 30 && !reducedQuality) {
      renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
      resize();
      reducedQuality = true;
    }
    host.dataset.drawCalls = String(renderer.info.render.calls);
    host.dataset.quality = reducedQuality ? "adaptive" : "standard";
    host.dataset.frames = String(renderer.info.render.frame);
  }
  frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  options.ready(true);
  return () => {
    disposed = true;
    cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
    resizer.disconnect();
    observer.disconnect();
    host.removeEventListener("pointermove", move);
    renderer.domElement.removeEventListener("webglcontextlost", lost);
    const geometries = new Set<THREE.BufferGeometry>(),
      materials = new Set<THREE.Material>();
    scene.traverse((obj) => {
      const mesh = obj as THREE.Mesh;
      if (mesh.geometry) geometries.add(mesh.geometry);
      if (mesh.material)
        (Array.isArray(mesh.material)
          ? mesh.material
          : [mesh.material]
        ).forEach((m) => materials.add(m));
    });
    geometries.forEach((g) => g.dispose());
    materials.forEach((m) => m.dispose());
    environment.dispose();
    renderer.dispose();
    renderer.domElement.remove();
  };
}
```

`main/ui/site/src/components/cinematic/neural-network.tsx`:

```tsx
import type { CSSProperties } from "react";

/** Editorial network topology, not a visualization of learned activations. */
export function NeuralNetwork() {
  const sizes = [6, 8, 9, 7, 4];
  const nodes = sizes.map((size, layer) => Array.from({ length: size }, (_, n) => ({
    x: 50 + layer * 125,
    y: 150 + (n - (size - 1) / 2) * 26,
  })));
  return <div className="neural-network">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 600 310" role="img" aria-label="Conceptual neural network with connected nodes and moving signals; not actual model activations">
      <defs><radialGradient id="neural-node"><stop stopColor="#f1fff9" /><stop offset="1" stopColor="#83b7ae" /></radialGradient></defs>
      {nodes.slice(0, -1).flatMap((layer, l) => layer.flatMap((a, i) => nodes[l + 1].filter((_, j) => (i + j) % 3 === 0).map((b, j) => (
        <path key={`${l}-${i}-${j}`} className="neural-wire" style={{ "--delay": `${-(i + j) * .3}s` } as CSSProperties}
          d={`M ${a.x} ${a.y} C ${a.x + 45} ${a.y - 35}, ${b.x - 45} ${b.y + 35}, ${b.x} ${b.y}`} />
      ))))}
      {nodes.flatMap((layer, l) => layer.map((n, i) => <g key={`${l}-${i}`} className="neural-node" style={{ "--delay": `${-(i + l) * .45}s` } as CSSProperties}>
        <circle cx={n.x} cy={n.y} r={i % 3 === 0 ? 8 : 5} fill="url(#neural-node)" />
        <circle cx={n.x} cy={n.y} r={i % 3 === 0 ? 14 : 10} fill="none" stroke="#91bfb6" strokeOpacity=".25" />
      </g>))}
      {['INPUT', '64 CHANNELS', '96 CHANNELS', '128 CHANNELS', 'POOL / HEAD'].map((label, i) => <text key={label} x={50 + i * 125} y="292" textAnchor="middle">{label}</text>)}
    </svg>
    <p>32 sequence samples → temporal convolutions → encounter signal</p>
  </div>;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties } from "react";
import { NeuralNetwork } from "./neural-network";
import sample from "../../../public/assets/observatory/encounter-sample.json";

const panels = [
  {
    title: "MATCH RECORDING",
    note: "Illustrative CS2 footage / separate from the analysis samples",
  },
  {
    title: "ENCOUNTER TELEMETRY",
    note: "Actual encounter summaries / de_inferno validation demo",
  },
  {
    title: "ENCOUNTER CONTEXT",
    note: "Recorded encounter summaries / not a raw 32-tick sequence",

    title: "TEMPORAL ENCOUNTER CNN",

  },
  {

  },

    title: "RANKED FOR REVIEW",

  },
];

export function PipelineCards({
  stage,
  motion,
}: {
  stage: number;
  motion: boolean;
}) {
  const host = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [foreground, setForeground] = useState(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    const sync = () => setForeground(!document.hidden);
    sync();
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", sync);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", sync);
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) =>

    if (host.current) observer.observe(host.current);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);
  return (
    <div
      ref={host}

                zIndex: active ? 10 : 6 - Math.abs(i - stage),
              } as CSSProperties
            }
          >
            <header>
              <span>
                0{i + 1} / {panel.title}
              </span>
              <span>NULLCS</span>
            </header>
            <div className="pipeline-card-content">
              {i === 0 && (
                <div className="pipeline-video">
                  {active && visible && foreground && (
                    <video
                      key={String(motion)}
                      src="/assets/observatory/nullcs-broll.mp4"
                      poster="/assets/observatory/nullcs-broll-poster.webp"
                      aria-label="NullCS CS2 gameplay footage"
                      autoPlay={motion}
                      muted
                      loop
                      playsInline
                      controls={false}
                      disablePictureInPicture
                      preload="metadata"
                    >
                      Your browser does not support video playback.
                    </video>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
              {i === 1 && (
                <div className="telemetry-sheet">
                  <p>EXTRACT / FIRST 7 ENCOUNTERS</p>
                  <table>
                    <caption className="sr-only">
                      Recorded encounter feature values
                    </caption>
                    <thead>
                      <tr>
                        <th>Row</th>
                        <th>
                          Aim error
                          <br />
                          (degrees)
                        </th>
                        <th>
                          Input
                          <br />
                          (units)
                        </th>
                        <th>
                          Angular speed
                          <br />
                          (degrees/tick)
                        </th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, row) => (

                          {sample.channels.map((c) => (
                            <td key={c.key}>{c.values[row].toFixed(4)}</td>

                  <div className="sheet-footer">

                  loading="lazy"
                />
              )}
            </div>
            <footer>{panel.note}</footer>
          </article>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { SceneOptions, SceneState } from "./instrument-engine";

export function InstrumentScene({
  mode,
  progress = 0,
  progressRef,
  stage = 0,
  channel = 0,
  samples,
  motion = true,
}: {
  mode: SceneOptions["mode"];
  progress?: number;
  progressRef?: { current: number };
  stage?: number;
  channel?: number;
  samples?: number[][];
  motion?: boolean;
}) {
  const host = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const state = useRef<SceneState>({ progress, stage, channel, motion });
  state.current = { progress, stage, channel, motion };
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const element = host.current;
    if (!element) return;
    let disposed = false,
      started = false,
      cleanup: (() => void) | undefined;
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        if (!entries[0].isIntersecting || started) return;
        started = true;
        void import("./instrument-engine")
          .then(({ mountInstrument }) => {
            if (disposed) return;
            try {
              cleanup = mountInstrument(element, {
                mode,
                samples,
                read: () => ({
                  ...state.current,
                  progress: progressRef?.current ?? state.current.progress,
                }),
                ready: (value) => {
                  if (!disposed) {
                    setReady(value);
                    if (!value) setFailed(true);
                  }
                },
              });
            } catch {
              setFailed(true);
            }
          })
          .catch(() => {
            if (!disposed) setFailed(true);
          });
      },
      { rootMargin: "200px" },
    );
    observer.observe(element);
    return () => {
      disposed = true;
      observer.disconnect();
      cleanup?.();
    };
  }, [mode, samples, progressRef]);
  return (
    <div
      className={`instrument-scene ${ready ? "scene-ready" : ""}`}
      data-mode={mode}
    >
      {mode === "hero" ? (
        <div className="hero-agent" aria-hidden="true">
          <div className="agent-portrait" />
          <span className="agent-registration agent-registration-top">CS2 / ENCOUNTER STUDY</span>
          <span className="agent-registration agent-registration-bottom">AIM / MOVEMENT / TIMING</span>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="instrument-fallback" aria-hidden="true">
          <div />
          <div />
          <div />
          <span>NULLCS</span>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="webgl-surface" ref={host} />
      {failed && (
        <span className="scene-fallback-note">
          Still view / interactive graphics unavailable
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
                <p className="mt-3 text-sm leading-6 text-zinc-300">{finding.body}</p>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          <p className="mt-5 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-6 text-zinc-500">
            These are review signals. They point to behavior worth inspecting; they do not identify a cheat type by themselves.
          </p>
        </div>
      </Reveal>
    </SectionShell>
```

`main/ui/site/src/components/layout/signal-constellation.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Pause, Play } from "lucide-react";

type Particle = { x: number; y: number; z: number; vx: number; vy: number };

export function SignalConstellation() {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    const ctx = canvas?.getContext("2d", { alpha: true });
    if (!canvas || !ctx) return;
    const surface = canvas;
    const context = ctx;
    const reduced = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
    const coarse = window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)");
    let width = 0, height = 0, frame = 0, last = 0, phase = 0;
    let scroll = window.scrollY;
    let particles: Particle[] = [];
    const pointer = { x: -1000, y: -1000 };
    const spacing = 145;

    function resize() {
      width = window.innerWidth;
      height = window.innerHeight;
      const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 1.5);
      surface.width = Math.round(width * dpr);
      surface.height = Math.round(height * dpr);
      context.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
      const count = Math.min(coarse.matches ? 32 : 85, Math.floor(width * height / 15000));
      particles = Array.from({ length: count }, () => ({
        x: Math.random() * width, y: Math.random() * height,
        z: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.7,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.22, vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.18,
      }));
      draw(0);
    }

    function draw(dt: number) {
      context.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
      phase += dt * 0.00007;
      const moving = !paused && !reduced.matches;
      const points = particles.map(p => {
        if (moving) {
          p.x = (p.x + p.vx * dt / 16.7 + width) % width;
          p.y = (p.y + p.vy * dt / 16.7 + height) % height;
        }
        let x = p.x;
        const y = ((p.y - (moving ? scroll * p.z * 0.065 : 0)) % height + height) % height;
        const dx = x - pointer.x, dy = y - pointer.y;
        const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
        if (moving && distance < 170 && distance > 0) x += dx / distance * (170 - distance) * 0.12;
        return { x, y, z: p.z };
      });
      // Spatial buckets keep connection checks local instead of all-pairs.
      const buckets = new Map<string, number[]>();
      points.forEach((p, i) => {
        const key = `${Math.floor(p.x / spacing)},${Math.floor(p.y / spacing)}`;
        const bucket = buckets.get(key) || [];
        bucket.push(i); buckets.set(key, bucket);
      });
      points.forEach((p, i) => {
        const cx = Math.floor(p.x / spacing), cy = Math.floor(p.y / spacing);
        for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
          for (const j of buckets.get(`${cx + dx},${cy + dy}`) || []) {
            if (j <= i) continue;
            const q = points[j], distance = Math.hypot(p.x - q.x, p.y - q.y);
            if (distance >= spacing) continue;
            context.strokeStyle = `rgba(78,166,255,${(1 - distance / spacing) * 0.22})`;
            context.lineWidth = 0.6;
            context.beginPath(); context.moveTo(p.x, p.y); context.lineTo(q.x, q.y); context.stroke();
          }
        }
        context.fillStyle = `rgba(139,205,255,${0.25 + p.z * 0.4})`;
        context.beginPath(); context.arc(p.x, p.y, 0.7 + p.z, 0, Math.PI * 2); context.fill();
        if (moving && Math.hypot(p.x - pointer.x, p.y - pointer.y) < 150) {
          context.strokeStyle = "rgba(104,193,255,0.16)";
          context.beginPath(); context.moveTo(p.x, p.y); context.lineTo(pointer.x, pointer.y); context.stroke();
        }
      });
      // Three open orbital traces add depth without filters or additional DOM layers.
      context.save(); context.translate(width * 0.82, height * 0.4);
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        context.strokeStyle = `rgba(103,176,248,${0.055 + i * 0.015})`;
        context.lineWidth = 0.8;
        context.beginPath();
        context.ellipse(0, 0, 170 + i * 65, 240 + i * 55, phase + i * 0.5, 0.3, 4.8);
        context.stroke();
      }
      context.restore();
    }
    function tick(now: number) {
      if (now - last >= 1000 / 30) {
        draw(Math.min(now - last, 50)); last = now;
      }
      frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }
    function sync() {
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      last = performance.now();
      if (!document.hidden && !paused && !reduced.matches) frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      else draw(0);
    }
    function onPointer(event: PointerEvent) {
      if (event.pointerType === "mouse") { pointer.x = event.clientX; pointer.y = event.clientY; }
    }
    function onLeave() { pointer.x = -1000; pointer.y = -1000; }
    function onScroll() { scroll = window.scrollY; }
    resize(); sync();
    window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
    window.addEventListener("pointermove", onPointer, { passive: true });
    document.addEventListener("pointerleave", onLeave);
    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", sync);
    reduced.addEventListener("change", sync);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", resize);
      window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onPointer);
      document.removeEventListener("pointerleave", onLeave);
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", onScroll);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", sync);
      reduced.removeEventListener("change", sync);
    };
  }, [paused]);

  return <>
    <canvas ref={canvasRef} aria-hidden="true" className="pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 -z-10 h-screen w-full" />
    <button type="button" onClick={() => setPaused(value => !value)} aria-pressed={paused}
      aria-label={paused ? "Resume background animation" : "Pause background animation"}
      className="ambient-toggle fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-50 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-sky-300/20 bg-[#080e19]/95 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-sky-200 shadow-lg transition-colors hover:border-sky-300/60 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary">
      {paused ? <Play size={12} /> : <Pause size={12} />}<span className="hidden sm:inline">Background</span>
    </button>
  </>;
}
```

```tsx
import Link from "next/link";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { ArrowUpRight, Menu, X } from "lucide-react";
export function SiteHeader() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const pathname = usePathname();
  useEffect(() => {
    setOpen(false);
  }, [pathname]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const close = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {

            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
          />
          <path
            d="M14 2v6m10.4 0-5.2 3m5.2 9-5.2-3M14 26v-6M3.6 20l5.2-3M3.6 8l5.2 3"

        <button

          aria-expanded={open}
          aria-controls="mobile-navigation"

        >
          {open ? <X size={20} /> : <Menu size={20} />}
        </button>
      </div>
      {open && (
        <nav
          id="mobile-navigation"
          className="lab-mobile-nav"

        >
          {[

            <Link
              key={item.href}
              href={item.href}
              onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
            >
              {item.label}
              <ArrowUpRight size={20} />
            </Link>
```

```tsx
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
      size: "default",
    },
  }
);

  extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>,
    VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants> {}

  )
);
Button.displayName = "Button";

export { Button, buttonVariants };
```

`main/ui/site/src/components/ui/hover-panel.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import { motion, useMotionTemplate, useMotionValue, useReducedMotion, useSpring } from "framer-motion";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function HoverPanel({ children, className }: { children: React.ReactNode; className?: string }) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  const x = useMotionValue(50), y = useMotionValue(50);
  const tiltX = useSpring(0, { stiffness: 160, damping: 24 });
  const tiltY = useSpring(0, { stiffness: 160, damping: 24 });
  const background = useMotionTemplate`radial-gradient(circle at ${x}% ${y}%, rgba(99,184,255,0.13), transparent 65%)`;
  return (
    <motion.div
      onPointerMove={event => {
        if (reduced || event.pointerType !== "mouse") return;
        const bounds = event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
        const px = (event.clientX - bounds.left) / bounds.width;
        const py = (event.clientY - bounds.top) / bounds.height;
        x.set(px * 100); y.set(py * 100);
        tiltX.set((0.5 - py) * 4); tiltY.set((px - 0.5) * 4);
      }}
      onPointerLeave={() => { tiltX.set(0); tiltY.set(0); }}
      whileHover={reduced ? undefined : { y: -5 }}
      style={{ rotateX: reduced ? 0 : tiltX, rotateY: reduced ? 0 : tiltY, transformPerspective: 900 }}
      transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 180, damping: 22 }}
      className={cn("group relative", className)}
    >
      <motion.div aria-hidden="true" style={{ background, borderRadius: "inherit" }} className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-300 group-hover:opacity-100" />
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  );
}
```

`main/ui/site/src/components/ui/parallax-media.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import { useRef } from "react";
import { motion, useReducedMotion, useScroll, useTransform } from "framer-motion";

export function ParallaxMedia({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const prefersReducedMotion = useReducedMotion();
  const { scrollYProgress } = useScroll({
    target: ref,
    offset: ["start end", "end start"],
  });

  const y = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 1], prefersReducedMotion ? [0, 0] : [28, -28]);

  return (
    <motion.div ref={ref} className="relative h-full w-full" style={{ y, scale: prefersReducedMotion ? 1 : 1.09 }}>
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  );
}
```

`main/ui/site/src/components/ui/reveal.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "framer-motion";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

type RevealProps = {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  delay?: number;
  y?: number;
};

export function Reveal({ children, className, delay = 0, y = 20 }: RevealProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, y, scale: 0.98 }}
      whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
      viewport={{ once: true, margin: "-80px" }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.7, delay, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
      className={cn(className)}
    >
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  );
}
```

`main/ui/site/src/lib/analysis-gateway.ts`:

```ts
import "server-only";
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { newSession, permittedPath, SESSION_COOKIE, SESSION_SECONDS, sessionOwner } from "./analysis-security";

function error(status: number, message: string, code: string) {
  return NextResponse.json({ error: { code, message } }, { status, headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
}

function workerUrl(value: string): string {
  const url = new URL(value);
  if (url.username || url.password || url.search || url.hash || url.pathname !== "/") throw new Error("Invalid worker URL");
  if (url.protocol !== "https:" && !(url.protocol === "http:" && ["localhost", "127.0.0.1", "[::1]"].includes(url.hostname))) throw new Error("HTTPS worker required");
  return url.origin;
}

async function smallBody(request: NextRequest): Promise<string> {
  if (!request.headers.get("content-type")?.startsWith("application/json")) throw new Error("Expected JSON metadata");
  const reader = request.body?.getReader();
  if (!reader) throw new Error("Missing upload metadata");
  const chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  let length = 0;
  while (true) {
    const { done, value } = await reader.read();
    if (done) break;
    length += value.byteLength;
    if (length > 4096) { await reader.cancel(); throw new Error("Metadata is too large"); }
    chunks.push(value);
  }
  const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString("utf8"));
  if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== "object" || Array.isArray(parsed)) throw new Error("Invalid metadata");
  const data = parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (Object.keys(data).some((key) => !["filename", "size"].includes(key)) || typeof data.filename !== "string" || typeof data.size !== "number" || !Number.isSafeInteger(data.size)) throw new Error("Invalid metadata");
  return JSON.stringify(data);
}

export async function analysisGateway(request: NextRequest, parts: string[]) {
  const path = permittedPath(parts, request.method);
  if (path === null) return error(404, "Analysis endpoint not found", "not_found");
  const secret = process.env.NULLCS_SESSION_SECRET || "";
  const apiKey = process.env.NULLCS_API_KEY || "";
  let base: string, publicBase: string;
  try {
    if (secret.length < 32 || apiKey.length < 32) throw new Error("Missing configuration");
    base = workerUrl(process.env.NULLCS_API_BASE_URL || "");
    publicBase = workerUrl(process.env.NULLCS_WORKER_PUBLIC_URL || base);
  } catch {
    return error(503, "Live analysis is not configured yet. The research pages remain available.", "not_configured");
  }
  if (request.method === "POST" && request.headers.get("origin") !== new URL(request.url).origin) return error(403, "Request origin is not allowed", "origin_rejected");
  let session = request.cookies.get(SESSION_COOKIE)?.value || "";
  let owner = sessionOwner(session, secret);
  if (!owner) {
    if (path !== "" && path !== "/capabilities") return error(401, "This browser session cannot access that analysis.", "session_required");
    session = newSession(secret);
    owner = sessionOwner(session, secret)!;
  }
  let body: string | undefined;
  if (path === "") {
    try { body = await smallBody(request); }
    catch { return error(400, "Send a demo filename and byte size as small JSON metadata. Demo bytes must be uploaded directly to the worker.", "invalid_metadata"); }
  }
  try {
    const upstream = await fetch(`${base}/api/analysis${path}`, {
      method: request.method, body, cache: "no-store", redirect: "error",
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(20_000),
      headers: { "X-NULLCS-KEY": apiKey, "X-NULLCS-OWNER": owner, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    });
    // Never return arbitrary proxy/server diagnostics or response headers.
    if (!upstream.headers.get("content-type")?.includes("application/json")) throw new Error("Invalid worker response");
    const data = await upstream.json();
    if (!upstream.ok) {
      const allowed = new Set([400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 413, 415, 422, 429, 503]);
      return error(allowed.has(upstream.status) ? upstream.status : 502,
        typeof data?.error?.message === "string" ? data.error.message : "The analysis service could not complete this request.",
        "worker_request_failed");
    }
    if (path === "") {
      if (!/^TEST_\d{14}_[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(data.job_id) || data.upload_path !== `/api/analysis/${data.job_id}/upload` || typeof data.upload_token !== "string") throw new Error("Invalid upload ticket");
      data.upload_url = `${publicBase}${data.upload_path}`;
      delete data.upload_path;
    }
    const response = NextResponse.json(data, { headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
    response.cookies.set(SESSION_COOKIE, session, {
      httpOnly: true, secure: new URL(request.url).protocol === "https:", sameSite: "strict", path: "/", maxAge: SESSION_SECONDS,
    });
    return response;
  } catch {
    return error(503, "The analysis worker is unavailable. Please try again shortly.", "worker_unavailable");
  }
}
```

`main/ui/site/src/lib/analysis-security.ts`:

```ts
import { createHmac, randomBytes, timingSafeEqual } from "node:crypto";

export const SESSION_COOKIE = "nullcs_analysis_session";
export const SESSION_SECONDS = 30 * 24 * 60 * 60;

export function signSession(owner: string, secret: string, expires: number): string {
  const payload = `${owner}.${expires}`;
  return `${payload}.${createHmac("sha256", secret).update(payload).digest("hex")}`;
}

export function newSession(secret: string): string {
  return signSession(randomBytes(32).toString("hex"), secret, Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + SESSION_SECONDS);
}

export function sessionOwner(value: string, secret: string): string | null {
  const match = /^([a-f0-9]{64})\.(\d{10})\.([a-f0-9]{64})$/.exec(value);
  if (!match || Number(match[2]) <= Date.now() / 1000) return null;
  const expected = signSession(match[1], secret, Number(match[2])).split(".")[2];
  return timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(match[3], "hex"), Buffer.from(expected, "hex")) ? match[1] : null;
}

export function permittedPath(parts: string[], method: string): string | null {
  if (!parts.length && method === "POST") return "";
  if (parts.length === 1 && parts[0] === "capabilities" && method === "GET") return "/capabilities";
  if (!/^TEST_\d{14}_[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(parts[0] || "")) return null;
  if (parts.length === 2 && ["status", "results"].includes(parts[1]) && method === "GET") return `/${parts.join("/")}`;
  if (parts[1] !== "players" || !/^\d{1,20}$/.test(parts[2] || "")) return null;
  if (parts.length === 4 && ((parts[3] === "explain" && method === "POST") || (parts[3] === "explanation" && method === "GET"))) return `/${parts.join("/")}`;
  if (parts.length === 5 && parts[3] === "evidence" && /^evidence_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,80}\.csv$/.test(parts[4]) && method === "GET") return `/${parts.join("/")}`;
  return null;
}
```

`main/ui/site/src/lib/desktop-release.ts`:

```ts
/** Only an operator-configured installer in the project's GitHub release assets. */
export function desktopReleaseUrl(value: string | undefined): string | null {
  if (!value || value !== value.trim()) return null;
  try {
    const url = new URL(value);
    if (url.protocol !== 'https:' || url.hostname !== 'github.com' || url.port ||
        url.username || url.password || url.search || url.hash) return null;
    const parts = url.pathname.split('/');
    if (parts.length !== 7 || parts.slice(0, 5).join('/') !== '/gjones01/NullCS/releases/download') return null;
    const tag = decodeURIComponent(parts[5]);
    const asset = decodeURIComponent(parts[6]);
    if (!tag || !asset.endsWith('.exe') || asset.length <= 4 ||
        [tag, asset].some(part => /[\\/\x00-\x1f\x7f]/.test(part) || part === '.' || part === '..')) return null;
    return url.href;
  } catch { return null; }
}
```

```ts
"use client";

import posthog from "posthog-js";

let started = false;

export function initPostHog() {
  const key = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY;
  const host = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST;

  if (started || !key || !host || typeof window === "undefined") {
    return null;
  }

  posthog.init(key, {
    api_host: host,
    capture_pageview: true,
    capture_pageleave: true,
    person_profiles: "identified_only",
    autocapture: false,
  });

  started = true;
  return posthog;
}

export { posthog };
```

```ts
import "server-only";

import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
import { promises as fs } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

export type ReviewReason = {
  title: string;
  severity: string;
};

export type ReviewPlayer = {
  steamid: string;
  attacker_name: string;
  proba_cheater_infer: number;
  risk: number;
  confidence: number | null;
  ci_low: number | null;
  ci_high: number | null;
  risk_band: string;
  features_summary: Record<string, number | null>;
  top_reasons: ReviewReason[];
  interpretation?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
};

export type ScoreTrace = {
  steamid: string;
  attacker_name: string;
  raw_proba: number | null;
  calibrated_proba: number | null;
  risk_display_value: number | null;
  confidence_value: number | null;
  gating_rules?: Record<string, unknown>;
  evidence_counts?: Record<string, unknown>;
  high_tag_flags?: Record<string, unknown>;
  why_risk_low_despite_high_tags?: string | null;
  feature_row?: Record<string, number | null>;
};

export type PlayerReport = {
  mode: string;
  demo_id: string;
  player: { attacker_name: string; attacker_steamid: string };
  risk: Record<string, unknown>;
  confidence: Record<string, unknown>;
  uncertainty_ci: unknown;
  reasons: unknown;
  signals: unknown;
  evidence_files: string[];
  interpretation?: unknown;
};

export type EvidenceTable = {
  demo_id: string;

  filename: string;
  columns: string[];
```
